verdict: M164 correctly specializes the M163r2 standalone Q8-input frontend to the frozen H67 maximum population. Exact-SHA VCS reaches 192000 samples per hidden lane and closes the declared signed tie, saturation and shift-23 vectors. Matched logic-only DC independently confirms exactly 2460 fewer sequential cells, 21.030313% lower cell area and 0.6439 ns more setup slack. These results are admissible only as a same-flow module-level logic-only A/B; PAFT, the fc1-to-Q8 bridge, the complete dynamic-BN barrier, rank3 correction/left projection, ATLIF, fc2 and network speedup remain absent.

vcs.receipt_accounting_error: per_hidden_lane_samples_total is hard-coded as 192650, but 19264 tiles times 10 samples/lane/tile is 192640. All functional queue and per-channel moment checks still close; this is a receipt/contract typo, not a datapath mismatch.

population_guard.predicate: reject when channel_count_q > 192000 - 2 before accepting the next two samples
population_guard.interpretation: The arithmetic guard prevents representational overflow. It cannot detect early-last, omitted, duplicated, reordered or lane-remapped spatial tiles because the interface has no expected extent or spatial address.

ownership.preclear_snapshot_semantics: Correct for the local protocol: the final accepted beat is copied into the snapshot while the active bank is cleared by later nonblocking assignments in the same clocked block. The next legal channel starts from the cleared bank.

operation_and_fifo.ii5_scope: Standalone accepted-beat geometry under a legal stream. It is not full-FFN or network throughput.

matched_dc.flow_match: same TSMC28 libraries, 3.0 ns clock, 0.2 ns setup uncertainty, 0.05 ns hold uncertainty, 0.25 ns I/O delay, flattened compile_ultra, ZeroWireload, ideal clock and zero macros
matched_dc.admission: The exact numeric A/B is admissible as a same-flow logic-only module comparison. It is not placed/routed PPA, energy, Fmax, physical speedup, FFN speedup or network speedup.

remaining_banks.m165_best_cost_target: Let the requantizer own/read a held raw bank directly. Two direct banks can remove the 912-FF quant_raw copy; a one-bank no-backpressure-II5 variant can remove 1824 FF total relative to raw2+quant_raw, but must quantify lost output-stall elasticity.

findings.title: PAFT and the real early-requant bridge are not admitted
findings.evidence: Inputs and factors are synthetic signed INT8. No checkpoint-derived rank3 factors, fc1-to-Q8 scale/shift, threshold bridge or valid825 result is bound to the sealed run.
findings.required_fix: Freeze the recovered PAFT artifact identities, validate valid825, and run a hardware-order golden bridge before any H67 accuracy or speed claim.

findings.title: This remains a frontend, not an equivalent complete FFN path
findings.evidence: Dynamic-BN coefficient generation, address-bearing barrier/replay, rank3 correction and left projection, ATLIF and fc2 are explicit cuts.
findings.required_fix: Build an address-bearing cycle model and compare complete dense no-running BN+sn2 against complete admitted rank3 right+correction+left under equal resources.

findings.title: The sealed sample-total receipt is off by ten
findings.evidence: 96320 beats / 5 = 19264 tiles, and 19264*10 = 192640 samples per lane; contract, pass line and receipt state 192650.
findings.required_fix: Issue a correction overlay or reseal the receipt counter; do not repeat 192650 in derived tables.

findings.title: Overflow prevention is code-reviewed but not attacked in sealed VCS
findings.evidence: The exact 192000 terminal value is covered, but the TB starts a fresh legal channel afterwards and never presents a 192001/192002 attempt to the full accumulator.
findings.required_fix: Add a non-last exact-max channel followed by one more beat and require sticky fail-close with unchanged state and drain-safe accepted outputs.

findings.title: The interface cannot authenticate the frozen population schedule
findings.evidence: There is no stage ID, channel base, spatial address or expected tile count. An early last, omitted/duplicated tile or lane remap can remain locally legal.
findings.required_fix: Put expected_tiles/channel_base/spatial_index into the scheduler contract or wrapper and fail closed on extent and ordering mismatches.

findings.title: The declared RNE cases pass, but the boundary suite is not exhaustive
findings.evidence: Signed even/odd half ties, gross positive/negative saturation and shift23-to-zero are explicit. Exact +127/+128/-128/-129 edges, half+/-1 for a wider shift, projection extrema and illegal shift24 are not driven.
findings.required_fix: Add these vectors in the next exact-SHA VCS run and separately cover illegal shift fail-close.

findings.title: The A/B is logic-only and has effectively zero hold margin
findings.evidence: M164 uses ZeroWireload, an ideal clock, zero macros and 1939 top-level ports; worst reported hold slack rounds to 0.0000 ns.
findings.required_fix: Keep the A/B qualifier. Add a realistic wrapper, storage choice, floorplan/CTS/parasitics and SAIF/PTPX before physical PPA or energy claims.

findings.title: No RTL-to-gate equivalence receipt exists
findings.evidence: Exact-SHA RTL VCS and DC are sealed, but the mapped netlist is not closed by Formality or an equivalent gate-level proof.
findings.required_fix: Run Formality after the active queue clears; until then cite synthesis metrics, not mapped functional equivalence.

findings.title: Signedness warnings remain in the DC frontend
findings.evidence: DC reports VER-318 conversions at RNE, square, sum, projection, row-sum and guard lines. Directed arithmetic agrees, but explicit casts would improve auditability.
findings.required_fix: Use explicit signed/unsigned casts and reseal only if the mapped logic or hashes change.

findings.title: The maximum-population SVA cover names only lane zero
findings.evidence: The TB scoreboard checks all 16 lanes and drives all lanes to -128, but the cover point itself observes moment_sum[0]/sumsq[0].
findings.required_fix: Add an all-lane signature or generate per-lane terminal cover points.

findings.title: Pre-run contracts remain in READY/admission-false state
findings.evidence: The sealed receipts are valid, but the immutable contracts still carry pre-run statuses and admission=false fields.
findings.required_fix: Add a post-run admission overlay instead of editing the exact-SHA precontracts.

allowed_claims: At exact sealed source hashes, M164 passes directed VCS/SVA including 192000 Q8 samples per hidden lane, signed ties-to-even vectors, signed saturation vectors and legal shift23.

The standalone frontend accepts one five-beat tile every five accepted cycles when downstream backpressure does not block it; the sealed maximum-population stream supplies 19200 consecutive tiles and the five-beat cover matches 19204 times overall.

Under the identical 3 ns TSMC28 logic-only flow, M164 versus valid M163r2 has 2460 fewer sequential cells (26.788631%), 11285.316025 um2 lower cell area (21.030313%), and 0.6439 ns greater setup slack.
The reported worst setup path moved from tile_channel_start->channel_sum_q in M163r2 to beat_expected_q->projection_acc_q in M164.
forbidden_claims: 192650 samples per hidden lane were processed; the derivable total is 192640
the exact-population test proves a correct full-network extent/address schedule
all RNE, saturation and overflow boundaries are exhaustively covered
the mapped netlist is formally equivalent to the RTL
21.03% area reduction is a placed/routed accelerator or system-level result
II=5 is complete FFN or network throughput
PAFT accuracy, physical speedup, energy, paper PPA, network speedup or headline speedup
